newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil launches over-the-counter stock market.
newsitem.headline: Brazil launches over-the-counter stock market.

text.p: A firm operating an over-the-counter market for shares not yet qualified to trade on Brazilian stock exchanges and modeled on the U.S. Nasdaq exchange was launched today in Rio de Janeiro.

The company, Sociedade Operadora do Mercado de Acesso S/C Ltda (SOMA), was founded by several Brazilian stock exchanges as well as the investment bank association Anbid, the listed companies association Abrasca and BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).

SOMA will start trading November 11 with shares of six companies, including state telecommunications companies from Rio Grande do Sul, Ceara, Goias and Pernambuco states, Pernambuco's power company and Sao Paulo's basic sanitation company.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
